handoff: Changes requested. Blocking: run view --why with no unit refuses with 'receipt undefined' and exits 3 instead of a usage error (exit 2); AC3 flags --full, --all and --story-only have no run list test. Minor: hidden help tier is empty and verbs are not grouped; AC6 write check misses gitignored paths; help <unknown> exits 0. Tests and typecheck green.

findings.title: `run view --why` without a unit refuses with 'receipt undefined', exit 3
findings.detail:
The old `why` took a unit as a required positional. In `why()`, `raw` is now `args.positionals[0] ?? (filter.receipt ? unitOfReceipt(...) : null)`. With `--why` and neither a unit nor `--receipt`, `raw` is null, and the code throws `refuse(`no tick in the trace applied receipt ${filter.receipt}`, …, 'no_tick')`. The message says 'receipt undefined' and the exit is 3 (refused) where a usage error is due. Compare the bare `run view` path, which exits 2 with usageError('run view: expected a run id or a unit'). Repro: `norn run view --why --json` in any norn repo.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: When there is no unit and no `--receipt`, throw a usage error such as usageError('run view --why: expected a unit', 'norn run view <unit> --why'). Keep the refusal only for a receipt the trace does not hold. Add a test.

findings.title: `trace` flags --full, --all, --story-only are untested under `run list`
findings.detail:
AC3: "every `trace` flag is accepted with the same effect" (verifier: test). Only `--events` and `--limit` are exercised through `run list`. `--full`, `--all` and `--story-only` have no test, under the old or the new name.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add `run list` tests (human or e2e) for `--full`, `--all` and `--story-only` that assert each flag's effect on the JSON.

findings.title: Prefactor 1 groups only partly built
findings.detail:
Plan prefactor 1: "`norn <noun>` listing its verbs in groups, and help printed in tiers with a hidden tier for `help --all`". `HELP_GROUPS` has a `hidden` flag and `--all` filters on it, but no group is hidden, so the e2e `help --all` test cannot tell a hidden tier from a visible one. `Noun.verbs` is a flat list with no groups. `run` needs no groups, and B1/B3 belong to slice 14, so this does not block.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add verb groups to `Noun` when `story` lands, or now. Give the `help --all` test a fixture that has a hidden group.

findings.title: AC6's 'nothing is written' check cannot see gitignored trace files
findings.detail:
The test checks `git status --untracked-files=all`. That does not list gitignored paths such as `.agents/norn/trace/`, so a trace write would go unnoticed.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add `--ignored`, or compare the file listing of `.agents/norn/` before and after the command.

findings.title: `help` with an unknown name or extra arguments succeeds silently
findings.detail:
`norn help nosuch` prints the full list and exits 0 (this already happened before the change). `positionals: { max: 2 }` lets `norn help init extra` drop `extra`. `norn help run nosuch` refuses, so the two paths now disagree. B5 wants unknown names to be a usage error.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Make `help <unknown>` an 'Unknown command' usage error, and refuse a second positional after a flat command.

findings.title: Small duplication and naming
findings.detail:
The ULID test on the target appears twice (cli run-view.ts and view run-view.ts). `v.name.slice(name.length + 1)` is repeated in cli.ts and help.ts. The padded help row is built twice in help.ts. A value in cli.ts is named `unknown`, which shadows the TS keyword. The cockpit action id is still 'trace' but now runs `run list`. `norn run --json list` silently shows the help and drops `list`. format.ts has a double blank line before `formatRunView`.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optional cleanup.
